admission.justification: Pinned download and newer machine uv were explicitly weighed; the choice continues to forbid host uv procurement and keeps host minimum policy separate from container certification.

alternatives.option: Use the PATH uv at the contract version or newer without installing uv.
alternatives.reason: The developer chose the machine-provided newer uv, preserving operator-owned tools and avoiding an extra installed copy.

alternatives.option: Download the contract-pinned uv into the product data folder for host setup.
alternatives.reason: It contradicts the chosen no-uv-download boundary and is unnecessary when the operator supplies a compatible newer version.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The developer explicitly revisits host tool ownership after evidence that supported machine uv versions cannot build the frozen environment.

consequences: Host setup compares decimal version parts and refuses older/missing/unreadable uv before environment mutation.
The certified container continues installing the exact contract uv; Python runtime and rollback checks stay unchanged.
context: An exact host uv pin refused a self-updating machine installation; a product-managed pinned download and using the newer machine uv were explicitly offered as alternatives.
decider: Developer D218, quoted in DEVELOPER-DIRECTION.md; approved minimum policy in MIK-R139@v1.
